**What would you like Sprout to do**

**Which of the design principles does it serve?**
See docs/02-app-design.md. Proposals that add a punishment, a loss-framed message, or a mechanic
without an off switch will be declined regardless of implementation quality.

**Is there evidence for it?**
Not required, but a citation from docs/01-research.md (or a new one) helps a lot.
